definitions.gloss: taking up a new post; assuming office
definitions.explanation: Arriving at and beginning work in a new position or assignment. Often used for diplomats, executives, or officials who have been transferred or appointed to a new role.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{着任|ちゃくにん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new ambassador took up his post.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{着任|ちゃくにん}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}します→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I will introduce the principal who is scheduled to take up the position next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{支社|ししゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着任|ちゃくにん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔合|かおあ}わせ→顔合わせ：10685_kaoawase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われた→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: During my first week after taking up my post at the overseas branch, I was busy meeting all the local staff.

notes:
USAGE:
{着任|ちゃくにん} is a formal word used in business, government, and diplomatic contexts. It emphasizes the act of arriving at and beginning a new role, often after being transferred or appointed. The antonym is {離任|りにん} (leaving a post).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着任|ちゃくにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take up a post)
- {着任|ちゃくにん}⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ (greeting upon assuming a new post)
- {着任|ちゃくにん}⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧ (soon after taking up a post)
- {着任|ちゃくにん}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧ (scheduled to take up a post)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {着任|ちゃくにん}: taking up a post (arrival and start at a new position)
- ⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧: inauguration (formal assumption of a high-level position)
- ⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧: proceeding to a new post (emphasis on traveling to the location)
- ⟦{退任|たいにん}→退任：14904_tainin⟧: leaving office (opposite of {着任|ちゃくにん})
